purpose: Offline research readiness ledger. It does not authorize hardware booting or flashing.

unresolved_blockers.detail: A real temporary-boot run progressed far enough to leave fastboot and enumerate an in-tree UFP-like USB identity, so the inherited relocation works at least far enough for substantial UEFI execution. Full pre-Linux ownership/safety is still not proven.
The inherited bootstrap participated in a run that reached UFP-like USB enumeration, which is positive runtime evidence, but exact CP2A compatibility and latent corruption risks remain unproven.
No fresh live CP2A fingerprint/slot observation is available after downgrade because normal setup/ADB is unavailable.
A current, verified recovery/backup path has not been recorded in project evidence.
Real hardware left fastboot and enumerated as WinUSB 045E:066B, strongly matching the bundled UFP application, but only a logo was visible and no normal UEFI console/frontpage was observed.

not_required_for_first_uefi_entry_but_in: PPTT cache geometry fields absent from DT (line size/sets/associativity)
